text:
marta: Heads-up: planning a tenant_id type migration for Chronicle in the quiet window (03:00 UTC). I9ll run a dry-run first and keep the live rollout pinned until we confirm safe backfill behavior.

deploy-bot: Dry-run started: chronicle/tenantid-swap (dry) at 2026-11-02T03:00:00Z. Tracking RB-4871.

ashwin: please ping when dry-run completes. if locks spike we abort.

kai: dry-run must exercise backfill path (not just DDL). last time KV cache coldness caused issues.

deploy-bot: Dry-run finished. DDL applied on canary; backfill ran on 4 partitions. Observed lock_wait spike on tenants 42-48. p95 ~19.8s. Logs: https://logs.internal/chronicle/dryrun/1791234567

marta: that's high. ashwin, any running jobs in that range?

ashwin: `SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE tenant_id BETWEEN 42 AND 48 AND state='running';` -> 17 (expected 1-2). nightly jobs overlapped.

kai: options: pause scheduled jobs during window, targeted replica backfill, or staged per-tenant switchover.

release-coordinator: ranked options: 1) Pause jobs + retry (lowest risk), 2) Staged switchover, 3) Reschedule window. Need owner & ETA.

marta: prefer 1. can SRE pause job runner for tenants 42-48?

sre-bot: Runbook SQL:
```
UPDATE scheduled_jobs SET enabled=false WHERE tenant_id BETWEEN 42 AND 48;
SELECT id FROM jobs WHERE tenant_id BETWEEN 42 AND 48 AND state='running';
```

ashwin: I can flip enabled=false in 5m. escape hatch: if lock contention persists we'll revert and keep rollout pinned.

marta: deploy-bot, pin live rollout while we coordinate.

deploy-bot: Rollout pinned: `chronicle/tenantid-swap --version=2026.11.3 --reason="pause for job freeze"`.

kai: run backfill to replica `chr-replica-7` with KV warmup, throttled.

ashwin: paused jobs. verification: 0 running jobs in range. starting backfill at 500/s.

sre-bot: Monitoring: p95 lock_wait dropped from 19.8s -> 1.3s after pause.

marta: good. once backfill finishes, run canary apply for tenant 42 only.

ashwin: canary apply scheduled at 03:55 UTC with `apply-mode=canary-host`.

deploy-bot: Canary apply running for tenant 42.

ashwin: canary succeeded, no elevated locks, tests green.

marta: ready to unpin and do staged rollout: wave1 tenants 42-44, wave2 45-48, 10m gap. rollback hatch: `deploybot abort-rollout --tag=chronicle/tenantid-swap`.

deploy-bot: Unpinning and starting staged rollout. Wave gap 10m. Notifying oncall.

sre-bot: Oncall notified. Wave 1 stable.

marta: wave 2 saw transient p95 6.2s on tenant 46 due to an analytics job; scaled it down, lock_wait returned to 1.8s. continuing.

nashwin: rollout complete for tenants 42-48. Post checks: `data-compat-check --range=42-48` and `kv-cache-prime`.

marta: running checks now.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete. RB-4871 closed. Release note draft posted to #release-notes.

release-coordinator: Adding perf numbers & runbook link before external note. Follow-up ticket AUTO-2445 created for auto-pause of scheduled_jobs preflight.

marta: thanks team 389. will add SQL and deploy commands to runbook.

ashwin: good job. can we automate detection + pause next time?

kai: +1 AUTO-2445.

deploy-bot: AUTO-2445 linked to RB-4871.

release-coordinator: closing thread, moving details to the migration postmortem.
